what_is_forecast: Whether SWS involuntary hunger in Balance Luzon (Luzon outside Metro Manila) in the target quarter will be significantly above its five-year normal (beyond the survey margin of error).
geographic_scope: Balance Luzon (regional). CALABARZON is ~34% of its population. Not a CALABARZON, provincial or municipal measurement or forecast.
measurement_type: forecast of a directly measured regional survey outcome (experience-based hunger), not observed prevalence

forecast.probability_note: In the walk-forward test, 3 past forecasts fell in the 0.4-0.6 range and 100% of them were followed by a HIGH quarter (mean forecast 46%). Few cases: read the probability as approximate.
forecast.class_rule: HIGH is raised when the probability is at least 0.12, the threshold that best balanced missed HIGH quarters and false alarms in training (fixed in FI7)

explanation: The outlook carries forward the latest SWS reading for Balance Luzon (23.6%, 2026-Q3) and lets it drift back toward the five-year normal (16.2%) by the fitted factor 0.67 per quarter. The significantly-above-normal line is 20.2%. No other indicator changes this number: in the locked evaluation no domain or news input improved the next-quarter forecast.

domain_context.note: Latest values known on the issue date, shown as context. They are not inputs of the served model, and the ablation found no measurable Lead-1 contribution from any of them.
